NBC Sports announced that NBA Whiparound will debut Monday, Nov. 2, following the Thunder-Cavaliers game. articles.title: Trail Blazers' Ja Morant exits first game vs. Grizzlies with hamstring injury
articles.summary: Ja Morant exited his first game against his former team in the fourth quarter Thursday night because of a left hamstring injury.

articles.title: Jose Alvarado Out Friday With Ankle Injury
articles.summary: Jose Alvarado is set to miss the New York Knicks' NBA Cup matchup against the Philadelphia 76ers on Friday due to a right ankle injury. Alvarado will now miss four straight games with the injury. Head coach Mike Brown did not indicate that it would be a long-term issue when discussing the injury on Tuesday. articles.title: Knicks To Decline Pacome Dadiet's Fourth-Year Option
articles.summary: The New York Knicks will decline Pacome Dadiet's fourth-year option worth $5.37 million, sources told Shams Charania of ESPN. Dadiet is set to become an unrestricted free agent in June. Dadiet averaged 1.7 points in 29 games last season. The 21-year-old has played just one minute this year.
